title: 第14章本座成亲了
slug: 二哈和他的白猫师尊皓衣行
content_zh:
那红纱轻薄，垂于眼前，虽然仍能视物，但多少还是有些看不太清楚。楚晚宁眉眼阴霾，沉着脸，由鬼傧相带到花厅里。
翻起眼皮，隔着软红，看到站在那里的人，楚晚宁周身的气温更是骤然低了好几度。
墨燃也呆住了。
不是……出来的不应该是师昧吗？
眼前的“新娘”红妆明艳，薄纱遮面，虽然五官在纱巾的遮掩下略显模糊，但怎么看怎么都还是楚晚宁那张俊冷肃杀的脸，正没好气地瞪着自己，那眼神活像要杀人。
墨燃：“……”
他先是茫然，而后神色逐渐变得极其复杂，各种情绪在脸上走马灯般轮换而过之后，最终成了一种诡异的沉默，和楚晚宁互相对望着，气氛尴尬到了极点。
偏偏两人身后跟着的金童玉女此时咯咯吱吱地笑做了一团，手拍手，开始脆生生地唱歌。
“白帝水，浪花清；鬼鸳鸯，衔花迎。
棺合，同穴卧；身前意，死后明。
从此黄泉两相伴，孤魂碧落不相离。”
这词曲鬼气森森，却又透着股缠绵悱恻。
如果可以发声，墨燃只想说一个字。
——“呸。”
可是不能说话。
台前有一对纸糊的男女，虽然没有脸，但衣着富贵华丽，略显宽松臃肿，应该是代指人已至年的高堂。
赞礼官又拖腔拖调地开始唱：“新妇娇媚欲语羞，低眉垂首眼波柔，红纱掩面遮娇笑，请来郎君掀盖头。”
“……”墨燃原本十分不情愿，但听到这里，却憋笑都快憋疯了。
哈哈哈哈，新妇娇媚欲语羞，啊哈哈哈哈！
楚晚宁脸色铁青，忍着怒气闭上眼睛，似乎这样就能连带耳朵也一起失聪似的。

鬼傧相嬉笑着递给墨燃一把折扇，“扇”与“善”同音，指的这桩婚事乃是善缘。
“请新郎掀盖头。”
墨燃忍着笑，倒是从善如流，握着扇柄将楚晚宁眼前的轻纱撩开，睫毛笑得簌簌，去看楚晚宁那张表情动人的脸。
似乎感受到对方讥嘲的目光，楚晚宁忍了一会儿，没忍住，猛地睁开眼睛，一双眸子里电光火石，满是剑拔弩张的杀气。
可配上他发上红纱，身上火红吉服，锐利虽不能减，但那因为愤怒和委屈而微微泛红的眼尾，居然别有一股独特的风流。
墨燃看着这样的眼睛，不觉一怔，笑容瞬时凝住了。面前的师尊，忽然和前世的某一时刻如此相似地重叠在了一起，他刹那间竟有些不知今夕何夕。
虽然只是短短一瞬，但也足以让墨燃冷汗涔涔了。
他曾对楚晚宁行了三件狠事：
其一，杀之，即对楚晚宁动了杀招。
其二，辱之，强迫楚晚宁与他欢好。
其三……
其三，是他上辈子做的最痛快的事，也是后来最后悔的事。
当然人界帝君是不会承认自己有什么事情是做了后悔的，只不过内心深处的煎熬，到最后还是逃不掉。
该死。他怎么又想起了那段疯狂的过往，又想起了那个时候的楚晚宁。
墨燃摇了摇头，咬着嘴唇，努力甩掉那张记忆里楚晚宁的脸，重新打量着眼前这个人。
楚晚宁一直在用“我杀了你”的眼神盯着他。墨燃不想惹这个刺儿头，只得装孙子赔笑，一脸无奈。
赞礼官道：“新郎新娘，行沃盥之礼。”
所谓沃盥，就是新婚夫妇之间要自己除尘洁净之后，再互相擦拭涤手。
鬼傧相端来装满清水的瓷壶，提起壶来请两人洗手，洗下的水由底下一只面盆接着。
楚晚宁满脸嫌恶，偏偏自己洗完还要替对方洗。墨燃因为有些走神，显得挺收敛，默默地替楚晚宁洗了手，楚晚宁则没好脾气，哗啦一下泼了墨燃一整壶，半边袖子都打得透湿。

“………………”
墨燃盯着自己湿掉的半边衣袖看了一会儿，不知在何处神游，居然脸上没有什么，只是墨黑的眼睛深处，隐隐有一些微妙的光泽在流淌。
他怔忡地想。
楚晚宁没变，从来都没变。
所行所为，所思所想，前世今生，都一模一样，分毫未改……
他缓缓抬起头来，甚至有那么一瞬，觉得自己是站在死生之巅，站在巫山殿前，楚晚宁从绵延的御阶之底向他走来，下一刻就要跪落在自己跟前，那清高的头颅要磕落在地，那笔直的脊梁将折辱弯曲，楚晚宁，要伏在他履前，长拜不起。
“沃盥礼成。”
鬼傧相陡然一声长唱，把墨燃从回忆唤醒。
他猛地回过神，对上楚晚宁一双眼，漆黑的瞳仁闪着凌冽寒光，犹如弯刀覆雪，令人心惊胆寒。
墨燃：“…………”
……呃，前生终究是前生，楚晚宁朝他下跪这种事情，这辈子还是想想就够了，若要实现，付出的代价着实太大……
沃盥礼之后是同牢礼，而后是合卺礼。
鬼傧相缓声唱道：“夫妇共饮一杯酒，从此天涯永不离。”
交杯合卺，而后共拜天地。
楚晚宁看上去真的快要气疯，他微微上挑的细长丹凤眼危险地眯着，墨燃估计出去之后他把那个鬼司仪剁成烂泥都是轻的。
可是这个样子的楚晚宁，真的不能细观。
哪怕再多一眼，都能重新堕入那些个凌乱污脏的回忆之，不可自拔。
“一拜——跪天地——”
原以为即使是逢场作戏，楚晚宁那么傲的性子，也决计不会跪的，可是没想到为了走完这一套步骤，他眉心抽了抽，闭着眼睛，居然仍是跪下了，两个人齐齐叩首。
“二拜——跪高堂——”

得嘞，就跪那俩没脸的纸人吧，那也能叫高堂。
“三拜——跪——夫妻对拜——”
楚晚宁垂着浓深的眼帘，看都不看墨燃一眼，转过身来，哐当一下气吞山河干脆利落迅速无比地伏下身去，忍得银牙咬碎。
谁知两个太不默契，靠的近了些，砰的一声就撞了个头对头。
楚晚宁痛得倒抽一口凉气，捂着自己的额角，抬起湿润的眼睛，凶狠地瞪着同样揉着额角的墨微雨。
“……”墨燃只得用口型说，“对不起。”
楚晚宁不言语，阴郁着脸，翻了个白眼。
而后是结发礼，赞礼官唱着“结发为夫妻，恩爱两不疑”，鬼傧相递来金剪刀，墨燃情不自禁地往后缩了缩，唯恐楚晚宁一个不高兴直接把自己给活活扎死。楚晚宁似乎却有此意，但最后还是只剪了彼此的一撮发缕，放入金童玉女呈上的锦囊，由“新娘”楚晚宁收好。
墨燃很想问他，你不会一怒之下拿我的头发去下诅咒，扎小人儿吧？
赞礼官唱道：“礼——成——”
两个都松了口气，从地上站起来。谁知下一刻那赞礼官又悠悠地喊了一声：
“良辰已至，送入洞房——”
什、么、鬼！！！
墨燃瞬间僵住。
一口老血，差点喷出！
开什么玩笑，他要敢跟楚晚宁洞房，这婚礼可就真他妈的要成冥婚了！虽说牡丹花下死做鬼也风流，可他这辈子想要……不对，他两辈子想要的人，都是出淤泥而不染的师昧，而不是这个会把觊觎他的人统统捆起来、丢到淤泥池里染染色的冷血魔头楚晚宁啊！！
现在逃婚，还来得及吗？
作者有话要说：谢谢22415376，阿里的地雷，么么扎。
唔，然后是婚词，原本想查查有没有固定的习俗唱法，结果并没有搜到特别详细的。而且因为是冥婚不能完全按正常婚礼的来，所以和真正唱词肯定不一样，考据党就不要细究抓毛病了，哈哈哈。
另外这个唱词其实特意加了一些细节，等全更完，如果有妹子有心，还可以回头看看，就会发现这个婚词不是完全的乱唱，其实是有含义的。

哒哒哒跑走，看，要洞房了哟，不直播吃翔了。
content_en:
The red gauze was light and thin, hanging down in front of her eyes. Although she could still see things, she still couldn't see clearly. Chu Wanning, with gloomy eyebrows and a sullen face, was brought to the flower hall by the ghost groomsmen.
Turning up his eyelids and seeing the person standing there through the soft red, the temperature around Chu Wanning suddenly dropped several degrees.
Mo Ran was also stunned.
No...shouldn't it be Shimo who comes out?
The "bride" in front of her has bright red makeup and a gauze covering her face. Although her facial features are slightly blurred under the gauze, she still has Chu Wanning's handsome and cold face, staring at herself angrily, with eyes that look like she wants to kill someone.
Mo Ran: "..."
He was at a loss at first, and then his expression gradually became extremely complicated. After various emotions passed through his face like a revolving lantern, it finally became a strange silence. He and Chu Wanning looked at each other, and the atmosphere was extremely awkward.
However, the golden boy and girl following behind them giggled, clapped their hands, and began to sing loudly.
"The waves of Baidi Water are clear; ghost mandarin ducks welcome them with flowers in their mouths.
When the coffin is closed, he lies down in the same hole; his thoughts before his body will be revealed after his death.
From then on, Huangquan and Huangquan accompany each other, and the lonely soul and blue fall are never separated. "
The lyrics and music are ghostly, yet full of lingering pathos.
If he could speak, Mo Ran only wanted to say one word.
——"Bah."
But can't speak.
In front of the stage is a pair of papery men and women. Although they have no faces, their clothes are rich and gorgeous, and they are slightly loose and bloated. They should refer to Gaotang, who is already in his senior years.
The salute officer began to sing again in a drawl: "The bride is charming and shy, her eyebrows are lowered and her eyes are soft, her face is covered with red gauze to hide her charming smile, please come and lift the hijab."
"..." Mo Ran was originally very reluctant, but when he heard this, he almost went crazy with laughter.
Hahahahaha, the bride is coquettish and shy, hahahaha!
Chu Wanning's face was livid, and he closed his eyes with anger, as if this would make him deaf along with his ears.
Ghost's best friend smiled and handed Mo Ran a folding fan. "Fan" has the same pronunciation as "kind", which means that this marriage is a good thing.
"Please ask the groom to lift his hijab."
Mo Ran suppressed his laughter, but he did as he pleased. He held the handle of the fan and lifted the gauze in front of Chu Wanning's eyes. His eyelashes were smiling, and he looked at Chu Wanning's moving face.
Seemingly feeling the other party's sarcastic gaze, Allen Chu endured it for a while, but couldn't help it. He suddenly opened his eyes, and his eyes were filled with lightning and murderous intent.
But with the red gauze on his hair and the fiery red clothes on his body, although his sharpness cannot be reduced, the tail of his eyes, which are slightly red due to anger and grievance, actually has a unique aura.
Mo Ran looked at such eyes and felt stunned, and his smile froze instantly. The master in front of him suddenly overlapped with a certain moment in his previous life so closely that he didn't know where it was now.
Although it was only a short moment, it was enough to make Mo Ran break into a cold sweat.
He once did three cruel things to Chu Wanning:
First, kill him, that is, kill Chu Wanning.
Second, humiliate him and force Chu Wanning to be happy with him.
Third...
Thirdly, it was the happiest thing he had done in his previous life, and it was also the thing he regretted the most later.
Of course, the emperor of the human world would never admit that he regretted anything he had done, but he could not escape the torment deep in his heart in the end.
Damn it. Why did he think of that crazy past again, and think of Allen Chu at that time.
Mo Ran shook his head, biting his lips, trying to get rid of the face of Chu Wanning in the memory, and looked at the person in front of him again.
Allen Chu has been staring at him with "I will kill you" eyes. Mo Ran didn't want to offend this prick, so he had to pretend to be a grandson and apologize, with a look of helplessness.
The salute official said: "The bride and groom, please perform the ritual of fertilization."
The so-called Wo wash means that newlyweds have to dust themselves and then wipe each other's hands.
The best man brought a porcelain pot filled with water and asked them to wash their hands., the washing water is collected by a basin at the bottom.
Allen Chu's face was full of disgust, but he had to wash it for the other party after washing himself. Because Mo Ran was a little distracted, he seemed quite restrained, and silently washed his hands for Chu Wanning. Chu Wanning had no good temper, and splashed a whole pot of Mo Ran, and half of his sleeves were soaked.
"………………"
The ink burned and stared at his wet half sleeve for a while. He didn't know where he was wandering. There was nothing on his face, but there was some subtle luster flowing deep in the dark eyes.
he thought in a daze.
Chu Wanning has not changed, and has never changed.
Everything he did and thought, everything he did in his past life and this life, was exactly the same, without any change...
He slowly raised his head, and even for a moment, he felt that he was standing on the top of life and death. Standing in front of the Wushan Palace, Chu Wanning walked towards him from the bottom of the long imperial steps. The next moment, he would kneel in front of him. The noble head would fall to the ground, and the straight spine would bend in humiliation. Chu Wanning would fall in front of his feet and bow to him.
"The ceremony is completed."
The ghost groomsman suddenly sang a long song, awakening Mo Ran from his memories.
He suddenly came back to his senses and looked at Chu Wanning's eyes. The dark pupils shone with a cold light, like a scimitar covering the snow, which was frightening.
Mo Ran: "…………"
...Well, the past life is the previous life after all. It is enough to think about it in this life. If it is to be realized, the price paid is really too high...
After the Woxi ceremony is the Tonglao ceremony, and then the Henuo ceremony.
The ghost groomsman sang slowly: "The husband and wife drink a glass of wine together, and they will never be separated from each other."
Make cups and drink wine together, and then worship heaven and earth together.
Chu Wanning seemed to be really going crazy. His slightly upward slender red phoenix eyes narrowed dangerously. Mo Ran estimated that it would be light for him to chop the ghost emcee into mud after he went out.
But Chu Wanning like this really can't take a closer look.
Even one more glance will make you fall back into those messy and dirty memories, unable to extricate yourself.
"Bow down - kneel to heaven and earth -"
I thought that even if it was just for fun, Chu Wanning's arrogant temperament would never kneel down, but I didn't expect that in order to complete this set of steps, he frowned, closed his eyes, and still knelt down, and the two of them kowtowed together.
"Two obeisances—kneel in the high hall—"
Okay, just kneel down to those two shameless paper figures. That can also be called a high hall.
"Three bows - kneel down - husband and wife bow to each other -"
Chu night Ning drooped his eyes deeply, without even looking at Mo Ran. He turned around, swallowed the mountains and rivers in a sudden, and leaned down quickly and swiftly, and could not bear to bite his silver teeth.
Unexpectedly, the two of them had no tacit understanding, so they got closer and bumped into each other with a bang.
Allen Chu gasped in pain, covered his forehead, raised his moist eyes, and glared fiercely at Mo Weiyu, who was also rubbing his forehead.
"..." Mo Ran could only say, "I'm sorry."
Allen Chu was speechless, with a gloomy face and rolled his eyes.
Then came the hair-tying ceremony. The praise officer sang "We are married as husband and wife, and there is no doubt about the love between the two." The ghost bride handed over the golden scissors, and Mo Ran couldn't help but shrink back, lest Chu Wanning would stab himself alive if he was unhappy. Chu Wanning seemed to have this intention, but in the end he only cut a bunch of each other's hair and put it into the bag presented by the golden boy and beautiful girl, and the "bride" Chu Wanning kept it.
Mo Ran wants to ask him, you won't use my hair to curse and prick a villain in anger, right?
The salute officer sang: "The ceremony - it's done -"
Both of them breathed a sigh of relief and stood up from the ground. Unexpectedly, the next moment the salute officer shouted again:
"The good time has come, let's send it to the bridal chamber——"
What, what, ghost! ! !
The ink burned instantly and froze.
A mouthful of old blood almost spurted out!
What a joke, if he dares to marry Chu Wanning, this wedding will really be a ghost wedding! Although it is romantic to die under the peonies and become a ghost, but what he wants in this life... No, the people he wants in his two lives are all teachers who have emerged from the mud and are not stained, not the cold-blooded devil Chu Wanning who will tie up all the people who covet him and throw them into the mud pool to dye! !
Is it still too late to escape from marriage now?
The author has something to say: Thank you 22415376, Ali’s landmine, Momozha.
Well, then there is the wedding lyrics. I originally wanted to check if there was a fixed customary singing method, but I couldn’t find anything particularly detailed. And because it is a ghost wedding, it cannot be completely based on a normal wedding, so it is definitely different from the real lyrics. Don’t go into details to find out the faults, hahaha.
In addition, some details have been deliberately added to this libretto. Once it is completed, if any girls are interested, they can look back and find that this wedding libretto is not completely random, but actually has meaning.
Da da da da ran away, look, it’s time to have a bridal chamber, no more live streaming of sex.
